India-born cheetah births four cubs at Kuno National Park

An India-born female cheetah gave birth to four cubs at Kuno National Park in Madhya Pradesh. The birth was reported by several centrist news outlets. The Statesman noted that the addition brings the park’s cheetah population to 56 individuals. The event marks a growth in the reintroduction program for cheetahs in India. No other authorities or organizations issued statements beyond the reporting of the birth.
